script	When people bake fresh bread, they say it feels easy because you can knead a dough in ten minutes. The trouble is, it only gets about eighty percent of the way on its own. To make the final twenty percent, you must watch each stage with care to be sure that the dough rises and the crust sets the way it is supposed to. That step usually takes five times as long as the first one. I've seen that happen more times than I can count. And if you're short on time, you might guess that a hotter oven or a longer rise will fix it. It's not. Most bakers won't say what's going wrong, but a good loaf only comes after you give the dough enough time.

script	When people bake fresh bread, they say it feels easy because you can knead a dough in ten minutes. That step usually takes five times as long as the first one. Most bakers won't say what's going wrong, but a good loaf only comes after you give the dough enough time. And if you're short on time, you might guess that a hotter oven or a longer rise will fix it. The trouble is, it only gets about eighty percent of the way on its own. I've seen that happen more times than I can count. It's not. To make the final twenty percent, you must watch each stage with care to be sure that the dough rises and the crust sets the way it is supposed to.
